subtitle.en: All 60 questions — pre-algebra through trigonometry, with pacing and calculator strategy.

note.en: Official ACT PDF with full-length practice test

downloadsInfo.introText: Take the ACT material offline. The PDF prints from your browser; the editable Word worksheet downloads instantly.
downloadsInfo.pdfCardDescription: All eight chapters plus every worked solution, formatted as a clean print document.
downloadsInfo.docxCardDescription: The 50-problem set with solutions as an editable Word document you can adapt for a quiz or drill.
downloadsInfo.worksheetLibraryText: 8 original ClipSAT worksheets with full answer keys, organized by unit — free to download and print.

testGenerator.introText: Build a randomised test from this subject’s question bank. Pick the number of questions and a difficulty, generate, then reveal the worked answers when you’re ready — or print a clean copy to hand out.
testGenerator.examDescription: Based on the ACT Mathematics test: 60 questions, 60 minutes, 5 answer choices, calculator permitted. Covers Pre-Algebra through Trigonometry.
